subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the 200-post clamp is fixed, should Mattermost cold-thread recovery intentionally await one bounded fetch and suppress retries after any failure for the remainder of the stored session?
rationale: Source and live proof establish that the design is bounded, but code review cannot choose the product tradeoff between prompt context recovery, first-turn latency, transient-failure recovery, and repeated server load.

options.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
options.body: Keep the current per-session one-attempt and in-flight coordination policy after clamping requests to 200 posts.

options.title: Retry transient failures
options.body: Add a narrowly bounded retry or cooldown policy so temporary Mattermost failures do not leave the entire session without recoverable context.

options.title: Reject awaited inbound recovery
options.body: Pause or close the PR if an awaited REST call on the first cold inbound turn is not acceptable for Mattermost.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded one-attempt recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the current per-session one-attempt and in-flight coordination policy after clamping requests to 200 posts.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with Mattermost ownership, making them the best available owner for the channel-specific latency and recovery policy.
